terms.sectionFiveBody: Ouiboo respects the intellectual property rights of others and expects its users to do the same. If you believe content on Ouiboo infringes your copyright, file a report on our copyright report page. Your notice must identify the copyrighted work, the allegedly infringing material and where it appears on Ouiboo, your contact details, a good-faith statement that the use is not authorized by the owner, its agent, or the law, and a statement, under penalty of perjury, that the information is accurate and that you are the owner or authorized to act on the owner's behalf. We review valid notices promptly and remove or disable access to infringing material, and we terminate the accounts of repeat infringers. If your content was removed in error, you may file a counter-notice through the same page and we will restore the content unless the original reporter files a court action. Our designated agent information will be published here when registration is complete.

billing.termsBody: Paid plans renew automatically at the price and period shown on this page until cancelled. We email you a reminder before each renewal charge. You can cancel at any time — cancellation takes effect at the end of the current paid period, and your listings stay live until then. Starting a paid plan means accepting these terms (version {{version}}).

evidence.title: Add completion evidence
evidence.instruction: After you send the refund, attach the proof here: the bank transfer reference (or your payment provider's transaction id) and the confirmation document (bank statement or provider receipt). Both are required — the case can only be marked completed on this evidence, never on a declaration alone. If the reference matches the provider transaction, the submission counts as a provider confirmation.
